# Insight to Action

> > Growth strategy consulting firm specializing in market segmentation, brand strategy, and product innovation for consumer brands.

Insight to Action (ITA) is a women-owned business enterprise led by Michal Clements, a former Booz & Co consultant and Wharton MBA. The firm helps consumer-facing companies develop data-driven growth strategies through customer segmentation, brand positioning, and channel optimization.

## Key Topics

- Growth Strategy
- Customer Segmentation
- Brand Strategy
- Market Research
- Product Innovation
- Demographic Segmentation
- Behavioral Segmentation
- Psychographic Segmentation
- Strategic Planning
- Pricing Strategy
- Channel Strategy
- Consumer Brands
- Business Consulting
- Michal Clements
- The Cambridge Group
